title: apricity steer: suggest re-harmonising a span to the chord the material actually plays
description: Found trying the harmony tools on examples/ave-emerge.apr: the weakest span (written VII, G) was heard as Em7/G, i.e. G6, because the loop plays an E there. steer's suggestions all tried to bend the loop toward G (undo the solver's shift, notch the E, EQ cuts); none improved objective_v2, and the heavy EQ scored -9. Rewriting the chord to what's heard (v7/3) raised objective_v2 88.4 to 89.6 (Q on the span 0.46 to 0.91), and the listener preferred it. Add a suggestion kind 'chords.respell' (op: rewrite the span's chord symbol to the heard chord, as roman numeral with slash bass where the language allows), ranked by projected dQ; guard it so it can't just chase noise (require high recognition confidence and a chord in or near the key; never change more than one span per step). Needs an explore op to rewrite a chord in the progression.
